acceptance.WG3-AC-04: pass — default hard set is product identity/facts, exact text, must/must-preserve/forbidden, size/count and reference binding; style, mood, background, palette, lighting, layout, reference treatment, preservation rules and model creativity stay soft unless an explicit user lock with a non-empty traceable basis upgrades that path. S07 emits hard rules from the same snapshot; S09 only applies hard rules and does not fold soft visual values into hard:composition.
acceptance.WG3-AC-05: pass — user_locks are part of the confirmation payload and immutable snapshot; adding or changing a lock changes the snapshot digest and _matches_existing returns false, so the old approval cannot authorise the new strength. acceptance.soft_unknown: pass at rule level — soft fields absent from blocking rules cannot create a hard unknown quarantine; T10/T87 regression confirms a default soft composition rule is not_applicable and the prompt flow continues.
